import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleDivisorPresentation
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SchemeEulerIndex
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.GenusFieldInvariance

/-!
# Degree of a divisor presentation after extension of the ground field

The two-affine Cech complex of a quasicoherent module commutes with field
extension. Its kernel and cokernel therefore retain their dimensions. Applying
the curve Riemann--Roch formula to divisor presentations of a line bundle and
of its actual pullback proves equality of their residue-weighted degrees.
This is the numerical input for powers of a fixed divisor Grassmannian twist.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Adelic

private theorem exists_chartTensorLinearEquiv {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hW' : IsAffineOpen (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) := (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := f.baseSectionsModule M W
    letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    ∃ Θ : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) Γ(M, W) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y', ⊤)]
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M, g' ⁻¹ᵁ W),
      ∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (x : Γ(M, W)),
        Θ (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x) =
          (f'.appLE ⊤ (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_top).hom b •
            pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) x := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) := (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := f.baseSectionsModule M W
  letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  obtain ⟨⟨Θ, hΘ⟩⟩ := exists_chartTensorEquiv h M hW hW'
  have hsm : ∀ (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) z, Θ (b • z) = b • Θ z := by
    intro b z
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
    | tmul c x =>
      change Θ (b • (c ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x)) =
        (f'.appLE ⊤ (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_top).hom b • Θ (c ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] x)
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', hΘ, hΘ, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_smul]
  exact ⟨{ Θ with map_smul' := hsm }, hΘ⟩

/-- The Cech complex on two affine charts commutes with an affine base change.
The comparison concerns the actual pulled-back module and its restrictions. -/
theorem exists_cechLinearEquiv_of_isPullback {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y'] [IsAffineHom g']
    (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) := (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := f.baseSectionsModule M V.U₁
    letI := f.baseSectionsModule M V.U₂
    letI := f.baseSectionsModule M (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)
    letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) (V.preimage g').U₁
    letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) (V.preimage g').U₂
    letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)
      ((V.preimage g').U₁ ⊓ (V.preimage g').U₂)
    ∃ (e0 : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
          (Γ(M, V.U₁) × Γ(M, V.U₂)) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y', ⊤)]
          (Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M, (V.preimage g').U₁) ×
            Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M, (V.preimage g').U₂)))
      (e1 : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) Γ(M, V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y', ⊤)]
          Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M,
            (V.preimage g').U₁ ⊓ (V.preimage g').U₂)),
      ((V.preimage g').moduleSectionDiffBase f' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)) ∘ₗ
          e0.toLinearMap =
        e1.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ((V.moduleSectionDiffBase f M).baseChange Γ(Y', ⊤)) := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) := (g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := f.baseSectionsModule M V.U₁
  letI := f.baseSectionsModule M V.U₂
  letI := f.baseSectionsModule M (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)
  letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) (V.preimage g').U₁
  letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) (V.preimage g').U₂
  letI := f'.baseSectionsModule ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)
    ((V.preimage g').U₁ ⊓ (V.preimage g').U₂)
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := exists_chartTensorLinearEquiv h M V.isAffineOpen_U₁
    (V.isAffineOpen_U₁.preimage g')
  obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := exists_chartTensorLinearEquiv h M V.isAffineOpen_U₂
    (V.isAffineOpen_U₂.preimage g')
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := exists_chartTensorLinearEquiv h M V.isAffineOpen_inf
    (V.isAffineOpen_inf.preimage g')
  let eD := (TensorProduct.prodRight Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
    Γ(M, V.U₁) Γ(M, V.U₂)).trans (e₁.prodCongr e₂)
  have heD (b : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (p : Γ(M, V.U₁) × Γ(M, V.U₂)) :
      eD (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] p) = (e₁ (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] p.1),
        e₂ (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] p.2)) := by
    change (e₁ ((TensorProduct.prodRight Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
        Γ(M, V.U₁) Γ(M, V.U₂)) (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] p)).1,
      e₂ ((TensorProduct.prodRight Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
        Γ(M, V.U₁) Γ(M, V.U₂)) (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] p)).2) = _
    simp only [TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
  refine ⟨eD, e₀, ?_⟩
  ext z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add z w hz hw =>
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.comp_apply] at *
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hz hw
  | tmul b p =>
    obtain ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ := p
    change (V.preimage g').moduleSectionDiffBase f' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)
        (eD (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] (x₁, x₂))) =
      e₀ ((V.moduleSectionDiffBase f M).baseChange Γ(Y', ⊤)
        (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] (x₁, x₂)))
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, heD, he₀, he₁, he₂]
    simp only [
      Scheme.AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiffBase_apply,
      Scheme.AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff_apply]
    have h₁ := chart_smul_baseMap_res f' g' M
      (inf_le_left : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₁) (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)))
      (g'.preimage_mono (inf_le_left : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₁)) b x₁
    have h₂ := chart_smul_baseMap_res f' g' M
      (inf_le_right : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₂) (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)))
      (g'.preimage_mono (inf_le_right : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₂)) b x₂
    rw [map_sub, smul_sub]
    exact congrArg₂ (· - ·) h₁ h₂

end Adelic

namespace Scheme

/-- The native Euler characteristic of a quasicoherent module is unchanged by
field extension whenever the scheme has a two-affine cover. -/
theorem chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_baseChangeField
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
    (V : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : C.left.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Sheaf.chi (toModuleKSheafOfModules (baseChangeField C κ)
      ((Modules.pullback (baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj M)) =
      Sheaf.chi (toModuleKSheafOfModules C M) := by
  let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))
  let C' := baseChangeField C κ
  let M' := (Modules.pullback (baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj M
  haveI : M'.IsQuasicoherent := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom _ M inferInstance
  let W := V.preimage (baseChangeFieldFst C κ)
  let A := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k), ⊤)
  let B := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of κ), ⊤)
  letI : Field A := (MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField k)
    (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toMulEquiv).toField
  letI : Field B := (MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField κ)
    (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of κ)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toMulEquiv).toField
  letI : Algebra A B := (f.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Module.Free A B := Module.Free.of_divisionRing A B
  letI : Module.Flat A B := Module.Flat.of_free
  letI := C.hom.baseSectionsModule M V.U₁
  letI := C.hom.baseSectionsModule M V.U₂
  letI := C.hom.baseSectionsModule M (V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)
  letI := C'.hom.baseSectionsModule M' W.U₁
  letI := C'.hom.baseSectionsModule M' W.U₂
  letI := C'.hom.baseSectionsModule M' (W.U₁ ⊓ W.U₂)
  let d := V.moduleSectionDiffBase C.hom M
  let d' := W.moduleSectionDiffBase C'.hom M'
  obtain ⟨e0, e1, he⟩ := Adelic.exists_cechLinearEquiv_of_isPullback
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom f) V M
  let ek : LinearMap.ker (d.baseChange B) ≃ₗ[B] LinearMap.ker d' :=
    AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.h0LinearEquiv _ _ e0 e1 he
  let eq : ((B ⊗[A] Γ(M, V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂)) ⧸ LinearMap.range (d.baseChange B))
      ≃ₗ[B] (Γ(M', W.U₁ ⊓ W.U₂) ⧸ LinearMap.range d') :=
    AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.h1LinearEquiv _ _ e0 e1 he
  have hk : Module.finrank B (LinearMap.ker d') =
      Module.finrank A (LinearMap.ker d) := by
    let e : B ⊗[A] LinearMap.ker d ≃ₗ[B] LinearMap.ker d' :=
      (LinearMap.tensorKerEquiv B B d).trans ek
    rw [← e.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_baseChange]
  have hq : Module.finrank B (Γ(M', W.U₁ ⊓ W.U₂) ⧸ LinearMap.range d') =
      Module.finrank A (Γ(M, V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) ⧸ LinearMap.range d) := by
    let e := (AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.cokerBaseChangeEquiv d B).symm.trans eq
    rw [← e.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_baseChange]
  rw [W.chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_eq C' M', V.chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_eq C M,
    W.chi_eq_moduleSectionDiffBase C' M', V.chi_eq_moduleSectionDiffBase C M]
  exact congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℕ => (a : ℤ) - b) hk hq

/-- Divisor presentations of a line bundle and its actual field pullback have
the same residue-weighted degree. This imposes no rational-point hypothesis. -/
theorem LineBundle.deg_divisorPresentation_baseChangeField
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (D : C.left.CurveDivisor) (Dκ : (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor) :
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
        ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
    ∀ (_ : L ≅ divisorModules k D)
      (_ : (Modules.pullback (baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj L ≅ divisorModules κ Dκ),
      CurveDivisor.deg κ Dκ = CurveDivisor.deg k D := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro e eκ
  haveI := hL.isFinitePresentation
  obtain ⟨V⟩ := nonempty_affineCoverMVSquare_of_curve C
  have hchi := chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_baseChangeField C κ V L
  rw [chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_congr _ eκ,
    chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_congr _ e,
    Sheaf.chi_congr (divisorModulesFieldSheafIso κ (baseChangeField C κ) Dκ),
    Sheaf.chi_congr (divisorModulesFieldSheafIso k C D),
    chi_divisorSheaf_genus, chi_divisorSheaf_genus,
    genus_baseChangeField_curve C κ] at hchi
  omega

/-- A divisor presentation of a line bundle extends to a divisor presentation
of its actual pullback with the same degree. -/
theorem LineBundle.exists_divisorPresentation_baseChangeField
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (D : C.left.CurveDivisor) :
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
        ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
    ∀ (_ : L ≅ divisorModules k D),
      ∃ Dκ : (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor,
        Nonempty ((Modules.pullback (baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj L ≅ divisorModules κ Dκ) ∧
        CurveDivisor.deg κ Dκ = CurveDivisor.deg k D := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro e
  obtain ⟨Dκ, ⟨eκ⟩⟩ := LineBundle.exists_iso_divisorModules κ
    ((Modules.pullback (baseChangeFieldFst C κ)).obj L) (hL.pullback _)
  exact ⟨Dκ, ⟨eκ⟩, LineBundle.deg_divisorPresentation_baseChangeField C κ L hL D Dκ e eκ⟩

end Scheme

end AlgebraicGeometry
